svg.title: Solana Indexer — hand-drawn architecture
svg.desc: Inputs feed subscription, normalization, a bounded buffer, routing and six protocol parser groups. Parsed events feed batched PostgreSQL storage, terminal output and dead-letter recovery. Features are listed on the left.

text.tspan: Decode → match execution → emit typed events
